description.en: Routing and playbooks for the 2found website reception.
description.vi: Điều hướng và cẩm nang cho lễ tân website 2found.

skills.description: Read FIRST for any product-choice, 'what is 2found', 'which product do I need', comparison or status question. Behaviour only: how to look product facts up with knowledge_search and cite the page, how to choose one product from the published need-to-product table, how to speak about any product that is in preview or development, honesty rules and Vietnamese phrasing. Product facts themselves are not here.
skills.name: 2found-routing

skills.description: Read when the visitor is evaluating or buying: wants a recommendation, asks 'how much / is it free / open source / better than X', wants a demo or a human, or shows buying intent. Covers qualification (one question at a time), price handling (look prices up with knowledge_search), competitor comparisons and lead capture with consent.
skills.name: 2found-sales-playbook

skills.description: Read when the visitor reports a problem, bug, complaint or asks how to do something and the product pages did not settle it; also before calling record_feedback for any kind other than lead. Covers triage, what to collect, privacy rules, record_feedback kinds and wording, and escalation. Fixes, per-product report details and support channels come from knowledge_search.
skills.name: 2found-support-playbook
